item.text: {"groups":[{"member_ids":["f4692139bbab9b69bd2b","b4df9ed4fb69bef2a8f0"],"operation":"Release a parsed document through XMLNode descendant cleanup.","condition":"The parsed document has child nodes and is destroyed or cleared.","capability":"XMLNode must safely delete descendants through the relevant DeleteChildren/DeleteChild or DeleteNode path.","consequence":"Descendant cleanup may fail during document release.","equivalence_reason":"Both describe the same child-bearing document cleanup obligation and the same potential failure."},{"member_ids":["377ea3c9bb55b4b4d17a","bb2ef91e3a32ce77b463"],"operation":"Call XMLDocument::DeleteNode with a null argument.","condition":"A caller passes null directly to XMLDocument::DeleteNode.","capability":"XMLDocument::DeleteNode must handle null before asserting about the node.","consequence":"The direct null call may trigger an assertion.","equivalence_reason":"Both describe the same direct null-argument operation, guard order, and assertion consequence."}]}
